ms.report:
１．We have finally released v0.2.0-alpha
https://github.com/btbf/sjg-tools/releases/tag/0.2.0-alpha
This version implements the following features:
・Initial setup
・Node type selection
・Chain selection
・Topology file creation
・Issuance of various key pairs
・Pool metadata creation
・Pool registration certificate creation
・Stake key registration
・Pool registration

ms.criteria: This version implements the monitoring tool setup, integration of the old SJG tool, and the ability to update pool registration information.
ms.report:
1．We have finally released v0.3.0
https://github.com/btbf/sjg-tools/releases/tag/0.3.0
During the development of v0.3.0, we decided to completely overhaul the code design. This decision was made with the anticipation that the codebase would expand significantly as we move toward v1.0, requiring greater maintainability.
https://github.com/btbf/sjg-tools/pull/8
Thanks to this decision, we made new discoveries and improved user operability, which we are confident was a very positive step forward.
This version includes the implementation of monitoring tool setup, integration of the old SJG tool, and the ability to update pool registration information.
